pages.title: Forge Hammer
pages.text: The Forge Hammer is a powerful tool that can break blocks in a 3x3 area. Perfect for mining large ore deposits quickly.$(br2)$(o)Mining Modes:$(br)• Normal: 3x3 area mining$(br)• Sneaking: 1x1 single block$(br2)$(o)Note: The Hammer takes damage when used in crafting and cannot be repaired.
